verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's public home page offers a processing-status lookup ('Find out where we are in processing your documents'). Its records can be searched by name, and annual reports filed online are processed and posted immediately, with free download once posted. Together these let a founder check filing status from public pages. Missing for 10: detail on how the status lookup works (inputs such as document or tracking number, what statuses are shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the tracker works.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Find out where we are in processing your documents.
Reports are processed and posted immediately.
Once the annual report has been processed and posted, you can download an image of the report free of charge.
